description: A braced ONE-statement event handler `onclick={ risky() }` whose whole body is an unhandled call to a `!` function. E-ERROR-002 fires once. Before S440 impl#1 compiled this at exit 0 while the multi-statement form errored — the split S439 ruling #14 rejected.
rationale: §19.4.3 / §19.4.4 — an unhandled `!` call SHALL be E-ERROR-002, and nothing exempts an event-handler value. §5.2.3: a one-statement inline block is equivalent to the bare shape of the same statement, and neither is exempt.
